description: One design: its sides and placement, warnings, whether it is approved for printing and whether production has its print files. withHashes adds its exact print spec and two hashes. The client shows these pictures to the person: refer to each by its label, and never write a preview link as a markdown image. Give it as a plain link only if the person asks to open or download it, or can't see it, and do not generate, draw or edit your own version of the shirt, design or product.
